description: This file defines the Ti50Emulator class which manages the lifecycle and setup of a Ti50 emulator instance within the Cuttlefish virtual machine environment. It includes methods for command generation, status checking, and initialization procedures, and it registers the emulator as a dependency and command source via the Fruit dependency injection framework.

classes.name: Ti50Emulator
classes.description: A class that manages the Ti50 emulator, including setup, command generation, and status checks, integrating with the Cuttlefish configuration and logging systems.

methods.name: Commands
methods.description: Generates a list of commands to start the Ti50 emulator if enabled.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the emulator feature.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if the Ti50 emulator is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: WaitForAvailability
methods.description: Waits until the emulator's control socket signals readiness and performs GPIO and TPM initialization.

methods.name: ResultSetup
methods.description: Sets up the control socket server for the emulator.

methods.name: ResetGPIO
methods.description: Resets the GPIO to initialize the emulator.

methods.name: InitializeTpm
methods.description: Initializes the TPM interface for the emulator.
